name: I Will Never Leave You Nor Forsake You
overview: The Scriptures affirm God's unwavering promise to His people that He will never leave nor forsake them, providing steadfast presence and protection in every circumstance. From the patriarchal assurance to Jacob that God will accompany and preserve him (Genesis 28:15), through the encouragement given to Moses and Joshua to be strong and courageous because the Lord goes before them (Deuteronomy 31:6, 31:8; Joshua 1:5, 1:9), to the comforting words of Isaiah assuring God's strength and support (Isaiah 41:10), these verses collectively reveal a God who is intimately involved, faithful, and empowering His people throughout their lives.
